# publicrecords MCP Actors

> Official public-records Actors for agents via Apify MCP.
> Published by the publicrecords maintainer on Apify.

MCP pin URL: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder,publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper,publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper,publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper,publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper,publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper

Hub: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/agents/
Prompt pack: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/agents/prompt-pack.json
Root index: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/llms.txt

## When to pick publicrecords
- Verified org socials (platform confirms website) → Crosswalk
- Official TED Search API v3 → eu-ted-notices-scraper
- Official USASpending.gov v2 → usaspending-awards-scraper
- Official Grants.gov search2 → grants-gov-scraper
- Official UK Find a Tender OCDS 1.1 → uk-find-a-tender-scraper
- Official Legistar Web API → legistar-meetings-scraper

## Actors
- Crosswalk — Company Social Profiles & LinkedIn Finder: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder — Find a company's LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok and YouTube from its website or name. Verified. Organizations only. Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/crosswalk/
- EU TED Notices: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper — EU public procurement notices from the official TED Search API v3. Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/ted/
- USASpending Awards: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper — US federal contract/IDV awards from the official USASpending.gov API. Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/usaspending/
- Grants.gov Opportunities: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper — US federal grant opportunities from the official Grants.gov search2 API. Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/grantsgov/
- UK Find a Tender: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper — UK above-threshold Find a Tender notices via official OCDS 1.1 API. Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/uktender/
- Legistar Meetings: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper — US city council meetings/agendas/minutes from public Legistar clients. Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/legistar/

## Tool cards (ideal inputs)
- Crosswalk single: {"query":"hubspot.com","outputFormat":"compact"}
- Crosswalk batch: {"queries":["stripe.com","notion.so"],"outputFormat":"compact"}
- Crosswalk Maps enrich: {"inputDatasetId":"YOUR_MAPS_DATASET_ID","maxRows":500}
- TED: {"keywords":"cybersecurity","buyerCountry":"DEU","maxItems":50}
- USASpending: {"naics":["541512"],"agency":"Department of Defense","maxItems":50}
- Grants.gov: {"keyword":"cybersecurity","status":"posted","postedWithinDays":30,"maxItems":50}
- UK Find a Tender: {"keywords":["cloud"],"noticeType":["tender"],"maxItems":50}
- Legistar: {"clients":["seattle"],"resource":"events","maxItems":50}

## Example prompts
- Resolve hubspot.com with publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder; return verified LinkedIn + Instagram.
- Call Crosswalk with query stripe.com and outputFormat compact.
- Enrich Google Maps dataset via Crosswalk inputDatasetId.
- Batch-resolve stripe.com and notion.so with Crosswalk.
- TED cybersecurity notices in Germany (buyerCountry DEU).
- USASpending NAICS 541512 awards; summarize top recipients.
- Who won Department of Defense contracts last 30 days (USASpending).
- Posted Grants.gov cybersecurity FOAs last 30 days.
- UK Find a Tender cloud tenders (noticeType tender).
- Seattle Legistar recent council events.
- Pin publicrecords MCP tools URL; run Crosswalk before outreach enrichment.

Disclosure: Published by the publicrecords maintainer on Apify.
